for 30 s your spells cost no mana and you take no damage.
Recovers 5 minutes after the rush starts.
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_boots.des: Self is built in: inscribe just the effects at the Scribes Table.
Crouch to cast the spell on yourself, paid with your mana.
A new spell replaces the old one.
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_gloves.de: A casting tool: use it to cast the inscribed spell twice for the price of one.
Inscribe a spell at the Scribes Table. Without a form it flies as a Projectile.
3 s cooldown after each double cast.
item.arcane_artifacts.ring_of_reversal.d: A hit stronger than half your maximum health is negated.
The attacker is thrown back one block per point of that damage.
Does not stop /kill or the void.
item.arcane_artifacts.mantle_of_reflecti: 50% chance to send any projectile back at its shooter:
Projectiles of your allies pass through.
arcane_artifacts.boots.invalid: The boots already have Self built in: inscribe effects only (no other form).
arcane_artifacts.gloves.invalid: The gloves cannot hold this spell.
death.attack.arcane_artifacts.parasitic_: %1$s withered away as a parasite's host
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_arcane: Launches an arcane missile that seeks the nearest hostile creature within 16 blocks, preferring creatures bearing an Arcane Mark, and chases it. It never targets its caster, the caster's team, tamed pets or summons, cannot pass through blocks and gives up a chase after a few seconds. Without a target it flies straight and fades away.

Brands the target with an arcane mark for 8 seconds, visible to every player. A creature can bear only one mark; marking it again refreshes the mark. Arcane Missiles and split projectiles prefer marked creatures.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_parasi: Binds the struck creature to you with a parasitic link for 8 seconds. While the link holds, every source of damage aimed at you strikes the host instead - before your armor or resistances apply, and with the host's own armor and resistances applied. The link breaks if the host dies or moves more than 32 blocks away. One link at a time; 20 second cooldown. Redirected damage is never redirected again.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_shrapn: When a projectile augmented with Shrapnel strikes a creature, it splits into two smaller homing projectiles that deal half damage and seek other nearby targets. Split projectiles never split again and do not strike the creature the original projectile hit.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_pursui: Sharpens the senses of homing projectiles: each Pursuit widens the target search radius, makes the projectile turn more sharply and lets it fly longer. Pursuit never increases damage.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_arcane_mi: The missile passes through an additional target or block.
The missile also collides with plants and other non-solid blocks.
Wider search radius, sharper turns and a longer lifetime.
On hitting a creature, splits into two half-damage missiles that seek other targets.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_arcane_ma: Increases the duration of the mark.
Decreases the duration of the mark.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_projectil: On hitting a creature, splits into two half-damage homing projectiles that seek other targets.
arcane_artifacts.page1.overview: Congratulations! You have found the notes of ???, a wizard of considerable talent and very little caution. Before reading further, please confirm that you are a wizard. If you are not a wizard, please stop reading. If you are a wizard, please also stop reading, put on a helmet, and then continue.
arcane_artifacts.page2.overview: In these pages you will find: a Research Table, five artifacts, a dozen glyphs and roughly forty ways to die. The author would like to stress that only three of those deaths were his. The others belonged to his apprentices, who have all been promoted to 'former apprentices'.
arcane_artifacts.page3.overview: Rules of the Handbook: 1. Nothing here can simply be copied: every recipe hides behind a research. 2. Read the instructions. 3. Do not cast anything at your friends 'just to see'. 4. If rule 3 has already been broken, see rule 2. Artifacts are made on the Enchanting Apparatus, glyphs at the Scribes Table.
arcane_artifacts.page1.rose_gold_ingot: 4 copper ingots and 4 gold ingots on a crafting table make 2 rose gold ingots. Used in almost every artifact. Also useful for making other wizards jealous.
arcane_artifacts.page1.wreath_of_manipul: Worn on the head. When your mana runs dry, the wreath panics on your behalf and starts a Battle Rush: for 30 seconds every spell you cast costs no mana at all and nothing can hurt you. Yes, nothing. Go wild.
arcane_artifacts.page2.wreath_of_manipul: After the rush the wreath needs 5 minutes (counted from the start) to recover, shown as Rush Exhaustion. The flowers glow fiery while the rush lasts and wilt to grey while it recovers. /kill and the void still work, the wreath is brave, not stupid. The recipe is expensive: two Source Gem blocks, two Nether Stars and a Wilden Tribute. Heroism costs.
arcane_artifacts.page1.focusing_boots: Worn on the feet. The Self form is already sewn into the soles, so at the Scribes Table you inscribe only the effects (Heal, Leap, Dig... your call). Crouch and the spell is cast on you, paid with your mana as usual.
arcane_artifacts.page2.focusing_boots: Holding crouch casts once; a short cooldown stops you from crouch-spamming yourself into oblivion. Other forms are refused: the boots know what they are and are at peace with it.
arcane_artifacts.page1.focusing_gloves: A casting tool held in the hand, like a spell book or a wand. Inscribe a spell at the Scribes Table (without a form it flies as a Projectile). Use the gloves: the spell is paid once and fires twice.
arcane_artifacts.page2.focusing_gloves: The second cast is free and never triggers a third, ??? checked. Several times. Loudly. After a double cast the gloves rest for 3 seconds. Doubled Parasitism still makes only one link.
arcane_artifacts.page1.ring_of_reversal: Worn as a ring. When something hits you for more than half of your maximum health, the ring says 'no'. The hit is negated entirely and the attacker is thrown back one block per point of damage it tried to deal. Hit hard, fly far.
arcane_artifacts.page2.ring_of_reversal: For arrows and spells, the shooter is the one who flies. Smaller hits pass through as usual, so death by a thousand paper cuts remains possible. /kill and the void are not impressed by the ring.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mantle_of_reflect: Worn on the back. Any projectile about to hit you has a 50% chance to turn around and go back to whoever sent it: spells, arrows, tridents, fireballs, splash potions, strongly worded snowballs.
arcane_artifacts.page2.mantle_of_reflect: The reflected projectile keeps its speed and its effects, and now belongs to you. Projectiles of your allies pass through, so you can still be hit by friends, which in a wizard party is statistically guaranteed.
arcane_artifacts.page1.status_effects: Things that can happen to you or to others because of this book. The book accepts no responsibility.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.arcane_mark: Placed by the Arcane Mark glyph for 8 seconds. A rune circle turns above the marked creature and every player can see it. A creature carries only one mark; marking it again refreshes it. Arcane Missiles and split projectiles choose marked creatures first. Harmful and curable: milk or Dispel remove it.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasite_hos: The creature is the host of a parasitic link: all damage aimed at the caster hits it instead, with its own armour and resistances. A tether of particles joins it to the caster. Ends when the link breaks.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasitic_bo: Shown on the caster while a parasitic link is active. Damage aimed at you is moved to the host before your armour and resistances apply. Void damage and /kill are never moved.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasitic_re: The Parasitism cooldown: 20 seconds from the moment a link is created. Casting a spell with Parasitism during the cooldown is refused before any mana is spent.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_arcane_: How it works: the missile scans 16 blocks around it (more with Pursuit) every few ticks and picks a target in this order: creatures with an Arcane Mark, then monsters and mobs attacking you, then others - the nearest one in each group. It never picks you, your team, your tamed pets or summons, players when PvP is off, or anything behind a wall. It steers toward the target every tick, so it can curve around. If it chases one target for 5 seconds without hitting it, it gives up on that creature for good. Without a target it flies straight; it fades after 10 seconds. On impact it resolves the rest of the spell like a Projectile, and Pierce, Split, Accelerate, Decelerate and Sensitive work as usual. Combos: Arcane Missile - Arcane Mark tags enemies for later missiles; Arcane Missile - Parasitism attaches a link from range; add Shrapnel and Pursuit for a swarm.

How it works: the mark is a status effect, so it is synced to every player and shows as a rotating rune circle. Only one mark exists per creature: a second mark refreshes the duration instead of stacking. Extend Time adds 4 seconds per augment, Duration Down shortens it. The mark itself does no damage - it is a target designator that Arcane Missile and Shrapnel understand.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_parasit: How it works: when the spell hits a creature, a link is created from you (the caster) to it. For 8 seconds, every time you would be hurt the damage is cancelled at the very first step and dealt to the host instead - before your shield, invulnerability frames, armour, enchantments, Resistance and absorption. The host then applies its own defences. Safety rules: redirected damage is never redirected again (two players linked to each other can not bounce damage); void damage and /kill always reach you; if the host is immune to that damage type (fire on a blaze...), it takes it as parasitic transfer damage instead, so an immune host can not shield you for free. The link breaks when the host dies, goes further than 32 blocks, you die, log out or change dimension. One link at a time and a 20 second cooldown; a second hit (for example the second missile of the Focusing Gloves) neither creates a new link nor extends it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_shrapne: How it works: when a projectile carrying Shrapnel hits a creature, two smaller turquoise homing projectiles burst from the impact point. They carry the same spell, deal 50% of its damage and seek the nearest other target - they ignore the creature that was just hit. Split projectiles never split again, so there is no chain reaction, and they cost no mana. Works with Projectile and Arcane Missile; Pursuit on the form also improves the split projectiles. Limit: one Shrapnel per spell.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_pursuit: How it works: each Pursuit (up to 3) adds 8 blocks to the search radius, makes the projectile turn sharper, lets it chase one target 1 second longer and lets it fly 5 seconds longer. It never changes damage. Pursuit only exists for homing forms such as Arcane Missile, because a straight projectile has nothing to improve.
arcane_artifacts.research_table.place_sa: Place a sample in the circle: an item, a material or a magical ingredient.
arcane_artifacts.research_table.nothing: The table finds nothing to learn from this sample yet.
arcane_artifacts.research_table.no_resea: No research is known on this server.
arcane_artifacts.research_table.unknown: An unreadable page. It needs knowledge you do not have yet:
arcane_artifacts.research_table.observe_: Place a matching sample on the table and Observe it to begin.
arcane_artifacts.research.needs_knowledg: This sample hides more, but you lack the knowledge to read it.
arcane_artifacts.research.principle: Principle understood: %s. Formulate it at a Research Table.
arcane_artifacts.research.unlocked: %s: the glyph can now be inscribed at the Scribes Table.
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Source Resonance
Source gems hum when magic is near. Learn how condensed Source answers to spells.
Cast any spell
Observe an amethyst shard or lapis lazuli to compare
Let a spell effect touch a living creature
Source is not a fuel but a medium: spells travel through it and shape themselves to what they touch.
Trajectories
Arrows fly, eyes of ender seek. Study how a moving spell can be steered.
Cast a Projectile spell
Cast a spell with Accelerate or Decelerate
Strike a creature with Harm or Knockback
A projectile keeps the intent of its caster; given senses, it can follow its target. (Arcane Missile, Pursuit)
Arcane Marking
Glowing ink stays visible in the dark. Can magic leave a sign on a living being?
Cast Sense Magic, or make a creature glow
Hit a creature with Hex or Snare
A spell can leave a trace that other spells recognise. (Arcane Mark)
Fragmentation
Crystals split along their lattice. Could a spell break apart the same way?
Cast a spell with Split
Break or Crush a block with a spell
Magic shatters like crystal: one impact can become several smaller ones. (Shrapnel)
Life Bond
Some creatures feed on others. Study how life force can flow between two bodies.
Wound a creature with Harm
Heal a creature with a spell
Afflict a creature with Wither or Poison
Two lives can be tied so that harm flows from one into the other. (Parasitism)
item.arcane_artifacts.researcher_noteboo: The notes of a wizard who signed only "???".
arcane_artifacts.gloves.empty: The gloves hold no spell. Inscribe one at the Scribes Table.
arcane_artifacts.book.locked_glyph:
The ink on this page swims before your eyes. Its glyph is still beyond you.

Research: %s
arcane_artifacts.page1.research_guide: Science! It goes in three steps. Observe: put a sample in the circle of the Research Table and press Observe. Nothing is consumed, not even your dignity. Experiment: the table tells you what to try in the world. Formulate: once every experiment worked, press Formulate and the recipe is yours. Applause is optional but encouraged.
arcane_artifacts.page2.research_guide: A research you are not ready for appears as ???. Do not panic, the page drops hints: another research you need (also ??? until you meet it) and a glyph of the Ars you must already know. Learn the glyph, finish the research and the page suddenly becomes readable. Magic!
arcane_artifacts.page3.research_guide: Notes come in four flavours: Material, Biological, Arcane and Spatial. They are never spent, because ??? refused to pay for knowledge twice. Important: only what you do AFTER a research has started counts. Setting yourself on fire beforehand is merely a hobby.
arcane_artifacts.page1.research_table: A table that tells you things about other things. Put a sample in the circle and press Observe: the table names its properties and starts every research it belongs to. The right page lists all researches, their experiments and what each unlocks.
arcane_artifacts.page2.research_table: The table never takes your sample and it cannot be lied to: an experiment counts only when you really perform it. ??? tried to convince it that he had been struck by lightning. The table waited. Then he was struck by lightning. The table approved.
arcane_artifacts.page1.old_parchment: Plain paper soaked in Source inside an Imbuement Chamber (500 Source, no pedestals) - just like an amethyst shard becomes a Source Gem. It ages instantly and never fades again, which is more than can be said for most wizards.
arcane_artifacts.page1.researcher_notebo: Eight sheets of Old Parchment and one piece of leather, crafted on a crafting table: parchment all around, leather in the top right corner. Contains this very book. Yes, the book contains its own recipe. No, do not think about it for too long.
arcane_artifacts.lore.research_table: "The Scribes Table copies what is known. I needed a table that would tell me what is not. It also tells me when I am wrong, which I did not order." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.old_parchment: "Old paper does not burn as fast. I checked. With my eyebrows." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.researcher_noteboo: "If you are reading this, I am either dead or very, very late for dinner. Probably both." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.rose_gold_ingot: "Copper drinks magic, gold holds it. And together they are pink. Nobody believes that this was not the point." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.wreath_of_manipula: "My mana ran out in the middle of a duel. I did not want that to happen again. Now when my mana runs out, my enemies would like it not to have happened again." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.focusing_boots: "Both hands busy, a mimic chewing my robe and no way to cast. Now I just crouch. The mimic was very confused." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.focusing_gloves: "Why say a spell twice when the hands can remember it? Also, my voice was tired." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.ring_of_reversal: "A troll hit me for exactly half of my health. I did math in mid-air. The ring is the result of that math." - ???
arcane_artifacts.lore.mantle_of_reflecti: "My colleagues answer arguments with fireballs. Half of the time, now, they win the argument with themselves." - ???
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Flesh Adaptation
Some creatures survive fire, water or blows by changing themselves. Learn how a body adapts to harm.
Get burned
Run out of air underwater or inside a wall
Take a blow from a creature or an arrow
Every harm leaves a lesson the body can learn - and pain itself holds energy. (Wreath of Manipulation, Ring of Reversal)
Focusing
A spell need not live only in a book. Learn how an object can hold a spell and release it.
Cast a spell with Self
Cast a spell with Touch
Cast a spell with Projectile
A spell inscribed into a worn object answers its wearer's movement and repeats itself in skilled hands. (Focusing Boots, Focusing Gloves)
Reflection
Shulkers hide in mirrored shells, shields turn blows aside. Can magic be sent back?
Be hit by a projectile or a spell
Cast Bounce, or knock a creature back with a spell
A moving spell keeps its direction only until something insists otherwise. (Mantle of Reflection)

arcane_artifacts.wreath.rush_started: BATTLE RUSH! Spells are free, pain is optional.
arcane_artifacts.wreath.ready: Ready: starts when your mana runs out
arcane_artifacts.silenced: You are silenced and cannot cast.
arcane_artifacts.weather.no_sky: There is no sky here to change.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_beam: An instant ray of magic from your eyes. It never passes through blocks: it stops at the first solid block and resolves on the first creature in its way (or on that block).
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_black_: Opens a small black hole where the spell lands. It pulls in creatures, items and projectiles for a few seconds and damages whatever reaches its core. The caster is never pulled, and blocks are never broken.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_tornad: Raises a tornado where the spell lands. It spins creatures and items around and lifts them into the air; when it dies down, they fall. The caster is never caught.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_weathe: Changes the weather. Without Amplify the sky clears, with one Amplify it rains (or snows), with two a thunderstorm breaks out. Only works where there is a sky.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_counte: Cancels magic. On a creature, every spell it has in play vanishes and it is silenced for a few seconds. On a block, every spell in play nearby vanishes, whoever cast it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_meteor: Calls a shower of burning meteors down around the place the spell lands. Each one bursts on impact, burning and throwing back the creatures around it. The caster is spared; blocks are not broken or set alight.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_time_w: Slows time around the place the spell lands for everyone except the caster: creatures become very slow, and projectiles in flight lose most of their speed.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_beam_glyp: The beam passes through one more creature.
The beam also stops at plants and other non-solid blocks.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_black_hol: Stronger pull and more damage in the core.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_weather_s: One: rain. Two: thunderstorm. None: clear sky.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_countersp: On a block: cancels spells in a wider area.
On a creature: a longer silence.
On a creature: a shorter silence.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_meteor_sh: Two more meteors over a wider area.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_time_warp: A wider bubble of slow time.
Time is only a little slower.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.battle_rush: Wreath of Manipulation. For 30 seconds spells cost no mana and you take no damage (except /kill and the void). Cannot be removed with milk, why would you.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.rush_exhaust: The wreath is catching its breath: no new Battle Rush until it ends (5 minutes from the start of the rush).
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.silenced: Counterspell. You cannot cast Ars spells until it ends. Milk helps. So does silence.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_arcane: Tip: the missile does not chase you. Unless you reflect it. Then it is technically your fault.
Tip: marking your friend 'so the missiles know who is good' is not how it works.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_parasi: Tip: the creature does not consent. The creature was not asked.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_shrapn: Tip: two halves of a missile are still a whole problem.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_pursui: Tip: the missile is persistent, not psychic.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_beam: Tip: the beam does not pass through walls. ??? learned this by standing behind one and laughing at a golem.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_black_: Tip: do not cast it under your own feet. Do not cast it under your friends' feet either. They will remember. If they come back.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_tornad: Tip: everything that goes up must come down. Fall damage is not a spell effect and is therefore not covered by the warranty.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_weathe: Tip: casting a thunderstorm while holding a lightning rod is a bold career choice.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_counte: Tip: if two wizards counterspell each other at the same time, they both stand there in awkward silence. This is called diplomacy.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_meteor: Tip: the meteors spare the caster. The caster's house is not a caster.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_time_w: Tip: time slows for everyone but you. Use the extra time to reconsider your life choices.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_beam: How it works: the ray reaches 24 blocks (+8 per Accelerate), stops at the first solid block and resolves the rest of the spell on the first creature it meets - or on the block if it meets none. Each Pierce lets it go through one more creature. Sensitive makes it stop at grass and flowers too.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_black_h: How it works: a 6-block singularity (+2 per AOE) lasts 5 seconds (longer with Extend Time). Everything inside is pulled toward the core - creatures, dropped items, arrows - harder the closer it gets. The core deals 3 magic damage twice a second (+1.5 per Amplify). The caster, spectators and creative players are ignored; blocks are never broken.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_tornado: How it works: a 4-block whirlwind (+1.5 per AOE) for 6 seconds. It spins creatures and items around, slowly pulls them in and lifts them; when it ends they fall. It deals no damage by itself - gravity takes care of that.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_weather: How it works: no Amplify clears the sky, one Amplify starts rain (snow where it is cold), two or more start a thunderstorm. The new weather lasts about 10 minutes (Extend Time makes it longer). Does nothing in the Nether or the End: there is no sky to argue with.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_counter: How it works: on a creature it destroys all its spell projectiles, lingering spells and walls within 64 blocks, stops its black holes, tornadoes and meteors, cancels the free repeat of its Focusing Gloves, and Silences it for 5 seconds. On a block it destroys every spell in play within 4 blocks (+2 per AOE), whoever cast it. Only Ars Nouveau magic is affected.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_meteor_: How it works: 5 meteors (+2 per AOE) fall one after another around the target and burst on impact for 6 damage (+2 per Amplify), less at the edge, setting creatures on fire and throwing them back. Blocks are never broken or ignited, and the caster is never hurt.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_time_wa: How it works: within 6 blocks (+2 per AOE) every creature except the caster gets Slowness IV (stronger with Amplify) and Mining Fatigue for 6 seconds, and projectiles in flight lose three quarters of their speed.
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Singularity
Ender pearls want to be somewhere else; obsidian refuses to be anywhere else. Between them lies the secret of pulling.
Pull a creature with a spell
Change a creature's weight: Gravity or Launch
Cast Wind Shear on a creature or cast a Projectile
Space can be bent toward a point - or along a line. (Beam, Black Hole, Tornado, Time Warp)
Firmament
Fire falls from the sky, the sky falls into rain. Learn who is in charge of the weather.
Set something on fire with a spell
Call lightning or a cold snap with a spell
Get burned
The sky listens to whoever shouts loudest. (Weather Shift, Meteor Shower)
Nullification
Milk undoes potions. Abjuration undoes spells. What undoes a wizard?
Dispel a creature
Observe a bucket of milk at the Research Table
Be hurt by magic
Every spell has a thread; pull it and the spell falls apart. (Counterspell)
